title: Bunk, Keppard, Oliver and Louis Armstrong
summary: Zardis heard Bunk, missed Keppard and Oliver, and talks about Armstrong at the Home.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Did you ever hear Bunk in the old days?
Yes, I heard Bunk, Bunk had a nice band, yeah, a really nice band.
Well I wasn't there when Freddie came, that's before my time. Yeah.
Yeah, yeah, remember Oliver, that was before my time.

Yeah, well, Louis, well Louis, he's around my age too. Well, Louis and I, we were back at the homes a while, see we spent all the time in the homes out there enjoying life, you know. And, well he's been back there a good while, him, but I stayed a year back there. But, uh, after I got back there, I mean, the trees were so nice back there, but I used to come home every Saturday at 12 o'clock and go back, go back there Monday morning, you know what I mean? Seven o'clock, I had to be back there at 7 on a Monday. And I stayed back there all the week, but that violent Saturday, I'll come home again, stay sad Sunday and come home. Yeah.
